messages:
maria-lopez: Quick sync — AcmeHealth private deployment readiness. We have the customer cutover window Thursday 03:00 UTC. Need final sign-off on VPC peering, NAT rules, and air-gap media handoff.

kevin-chen: I'm good for the window. Our side: gateway setup + BGP session tested in the staging VPC. Waiting on their BGP ASN and tunnel pre-shared key. I sent them the `bgp-config-v2` snippet yesterday.

sophia-park: From infra side, we still have a packaging question: the air-gapped bundle is ~6.2GB after dedupe. Ops asked if we can split into two volumes so they can rsync over lower-bandwidth link. Is that allowed by the install script?

jamal-harris: You can split it — installer supports chunked manifests. Use `./installer --from-chunk=1 --chunks=2`. I tested with a dummy bundle. Need to update the runbook with the chunk example.

maria-lopez: Awesome, please add the chunk flags to the runbook. Also need confirmation on service account keys: customer will provide a K8s service account token and our terraform will consume it. Are there RBAC scopes documented?

kevin-chen: RBAC doc: we require `cluster-admin` on the bootstrap namespace only (we revoke after install). I'll drop a short excerpt into the ticket.

sophia-park: Network check: customer firewall requires explicit egress for our healthcheck endpoints. List below — confirm these are final: `api.redwood.prod:443`, `metrics.redwood.prod:9090`, `artifact-storage.redwood.s3:443`.

kevin-chen: Add `ntp.pool.org:123` as well — their nodes were drifting during the last cutover and that caused cert validation failures.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist:peering-status changed from pending to partial OK (2/3 tunnels established).

maria-lopez: Thanks infra-bot. Kevin, can you own peering completion and verify tunnel 3 (customer->us) before Thursday? If that slips we should push the window.

kevin-chen: I will own it. Plan: - confirm PSK with customer by EOD PST - run `ip route` + `show bgp summary` after handshake - coordinate with Sophia for any firewall tweak.

jamal-harris: Small blocker: the customer's air-gap endpoint uses a nonstandard TLS profile (no SNI). Our current installer expects SNI; I have a patch branch that falls back. Need one more reviewer before I merge.

sophia-park: I'll review jamal's patch today. If it looks good, we can include it in the cutover build.

maria-lopez: Ownership recap: Kevin -> peering & BGP; Jamal -> installer SNI fallback patch + runbook chunk example; Sophia -> packaging + firewall egress list; Maria -> cutover coordination & customer comms.

kevin-chen: Noted. I'll ping them again and post the PSK to the ticket (don't paste secrets in slack).

maria-lopez: One more ask — can someone run a final smoke on the private build in our staging region tomorrow morning (02:00 UTC)? We need to confirm image signatures and helm chart render.

jamal-harris: I can run smoke at 02:00 UTC. I'll post the logs to the ticket and attach `smoke-02-priv.log`. If anything fails, we decide go/no-go by 02:45.

infra-bot: reminder: runbook-update required field missing: "chunking_examples".

maria-lopez: Perfect. If reviews + peering finish by EOD we'll keep Thursday. Otherwise we tentatively slip to Saturday same window. Any objections? :thumbsup: -> keep Thursday, :thumbsdown: -> slip.

sophia-park: :thumbsup:
kevin-chen: :thumbsup:
jamal-harris: :thumbsup:

maria-lopez: Great — I'll send the calendar invite and the customer-facing checklist. Thanks all.
